room-3d: Welcome to Chess Arena. This is the three-D room. Watch it orbit while the pieces play — a live game, not a still image.
camera: You can spin the room yourself. Free drag orbits the camera. Fixed locks a preset angle. On a phone, tap Cam to open these controls.
board-2d: If you prefer a flat board, two-D is right here. Same game. The room stays three-D by default — this is just an option.
view-toggle: Use this switch anytime to flip between two-D and three-D. Themes live here too. We'll stay in the three-D room for the rest of the tour.
mobile-bar: This bar is for phones. You can see whose turn it is, step through moves, and open Menu for the full game panel.
sidebar-game: This is the game panel. Room code, mode, and whose turn it is. On a phone, it slides up from Menu.
sidebar-history: Time travel. Step back and forward through the game without changing the live position.
sidebar-coach: Coach is here for bot and local games. You can ask for a hint, review the last move, or scan for threats.
sidebar-invite: Playing online? You'll get a share link. Your friend sits as Black on their own device.
sidebar-actions: Here you can offer a draw, claim a draw, or resign — or wait for your opponent to reply.
sidebar-moves: Every move lands in this list, in standard chess notation, so you can recap the game at a glance.
sidebar-leave: Leave the room anytime. Your next game starts from the lobby.
brand: This is the Chess Arena lobby. Home base for online rooms, bots, and hot-seat — in two-D or immersive three-D.
theme: Swap the board and room looks here. Your pick is saved for next time.
nav: Sign in for your profile, friends, challenges, and the leaderboard. Guests can still play.
play: Four ways in. Play versus a bot as either color, create an online room, or hot-seat on one device.
play-bot: Play versus Bot. Practice against the engine as White. Tap the card to jump into a room.
play-bot-black: Or take Black, and let the engine move first. That's a great way to learn defense.
play-online: Create an online room, copy the invite, and play live over the web.
play-local: Hot seat. Two players, one screen. Pass the device between White and Black.
bot-level: Pick the bot's strength before you start — beginner through master.
join: Already have a room? Paste a room code or invite link to sit as the second player.
server: This is the live chess server. If it's waking up, wait a moment and retry.
lobby-hero: That's the battlefield: procedural three-D pieces, live multiplayer, adjustable bots, and a built-in coach.
lobby-features: You also get legal-move hints, drag and drop, ratings, friends, and more — all in one arena.
done: You're in. Orbit the room, drag pieces to move, and use Menu on mobile. You can replay this tour anytime from Tutorial.
